tagline: Write with context. Publish with control.
emptyBody: Model setup and focused writing tools arrive in the next implementation phase.
emptyAction: Start with an idea, keep the final word.
settingsBody: Your provider settings stay in this browser. PostMuse never receives your key.
apiKeyHint: The key is never shown again after saving.
apiKeyReplaceHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key, or enter a new one to replace it.
storageSessionHint: Safer default. Cleared when Chrome restarts.
storageLocalHint: Persists across restarts. Use only on a trusted device.
baseUrlHint: HTTPS is required. Localhost HTTP is available for development.
mockTestNote: Phase 1 test: checks storage, permission, model and key presence. No provider request is sent.
mockTestPassed: Local setup check passed for {model}. No network request was sent.
errorKeyRequired: Add an API key before testing the setup.
errorKeyReentry: Re-enter the API key when changing how it is stored.
errorPermissionRequired: Provider host permission is required for this setup.
errorModelRequired: Choose a model before testing the setup.
errorInvalidSettings: Check the provider settings and try again.
createTitle: Turn an idea into a post
createBody: Shape a standalone post, reply, quote, thread, or Premium long post. You edit and publish the final version.
sourcePlaceholder: What do you want to say? Add the useful context, rough wording, or an existing draft.
configureModelBody: Add a model and API key in Settings. Your draft stays local until you generate.
localDraftNote: Drafts stay in this panel and are not sent until you generate.
providerDisclosure: Generate sends this draft directly to {provider} at {origin}. PostMuse has no server.
sourceRequired: Add an idea, draft, or text file before generating.
fileSizeError: The file is larger than 1 MiB. Choose a smaller file.
fileReadError: The text file could not be read.
errorAuthInvalid: The Provider rejected the API key.
errorModelForbidden: This API key cannot access the selected model.
errorModelNotFound: The model or Provider endpoint was not found.
errorEndpointNotFound: The Provider endpoint redirected or could not be used safely.
errorProviderRequestInvalid: The Provider rejected these request parameters.
errorRateLimited: The Provider rate limit or quota was reached.
errorTimeout: The Provider took too long to respond.
errorNetwork: The Provider could not be reached.
errorContentRejected: The Provider declined to generate this content.
errorOutputInvalid: The Provider returned an unreadable response.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
rawFallbackNotice: The Provider did not return valid structured JSON. The original text is preserved for editing and copying.
partialResultNotice: The Provider returned fewer usable items than requested. Available drafts are preserved.
longPostNotice: Premium availability and final length are determined by your X account. This is a plain-text long post, not an X Article.
